name: Regal Airport Hotel
detail: I was only there one day but could see that it is a top-class hotel. It has al the mod-cons in the room including a massive LED TV with a welcoming message for you and even speakers in the bathroom. Going to this hotel also really helped as I arrived at about 1am in Hong Kong and so didn't need to look for taxis or late-night transport and then hassle with check-ins in Hong Kong City. Most times you can only check in after 2pm anyway. And the good thing is it is not any more expensive than the normal (and usually much smaller) hotels in Hong Kong City.

name: Woody House
detail: Been in HK multiple times and this is one of the best stays.

name: Ramada Hong Kong Harbour View
detail: I would say it is the Best Price ever if you would like to have a short stay in Hong Kong only for some good sleeping time every night. The location is fantastic. You can walk to Centre. The variety and food around the hotel are good and value for money. Hong Kong is small! You can not expect to have a large room like when you are doing a budget traveling in United States of America. Definitely worth it even though the space is small but, it is the best price ever in Hong Kong in a 4-star hotel. Good customer service! Excellent!
area: Hong Kong Island West,Hong Kong - View on map

name: Mini Central
detail: It was quite a walk up the steep slopes and stairs, but hey, it is hong kong after all right? Though the hotel was found sandwiched between two other building, it stood out due to it's small build making it easy to find. Entering the hotel, we were greeted with a very beautifully lobby area which was furnished with modern and contemporary furniture. There were two imacs available for use and even a piano, which i was very much tempted to play but my next to zero instrumental skills prevented me. We were briskly checked in and showed to our room by the efficient, if not so friendly, staffs there. We weren't exactly shocked by the size of the room, having done our research prior to booking the room. In fact, i actually felt that it was better than i'd expected it to be! It would've been very annoying to move around if we had brought big luggages but we were only travelling with backpacks so it wasn't really much of a hassle for us! Besides, when you're in hong kong you wouldn't be staying in that much since there's lots to do. Aside from that, i actually like the fact that the toilet had clear glass walls. It allowed me to watch the telly, not that there was anything to watch actually considering the limited channels they have, and go about my big business all at the same time. Also, toiletries was not provided but can be easily bought from a dispenser at the ground floor, Overall, we're really satisfied with our stay there. It was a really nice hotel with an affordable price. Unless you really don't enjoy small spaces i'm pretty sure you'll like the place! Well, we definitely did and wouldn't mind coming back if i were to visit hong kong again!

name: Nina Hotel Tsuen Wan West
detail: From Sept 15th to 17th, I stayed in this wonderful Hotel together with my wife and 4 colleagues (we were on a company trip). This is my 3rd trip to Hong Kong and I must say although I paid much more for the previous 2 hotels in Hong Kong Island, but this is by far the best hotel I have ever stayed in Hong Kong or anywhere else! From the airport, we chose to take Bus no. A31 to take us to the hotel. The bus journey took about 55 minutes and we arrived at the hotel at about almost 8.00 p.m. Upon my arrival, I was greeted by a very pleasant and friendly receptionist at the hotel who had so kindly agreed to upgrade my 3 original Standard rooms at Tower 1 into one room at Harbour View - Tower 2 (on the 85th floor!) and another Family suite room at the 82nd Floor for my 4 other colleagues! The view at both our hotel rooms were phenomenal! And I really loved my Harbour View room as the design was modern and nice and the King size bed was very comfortable. However, special mention needs to be given to the Family Suite Room here - it is Really Spacious and beautiful. There were 2 Queen size beds plus 2 single beds in the suite and it has everything- a fridge, 2 round tables, kitchen cabinets etc! I really think the hotel has been extremely generous to exchange this suite room with my original 2 standard rooms at tower 1! Meals were not a problem at all as there are very nice dim sum and chinese restaurants in and nearby the hotel. The Tsuen Wan West MTR station was also very nearby the hotel (about 15 minutes walk away) and during my 2 night stay there at the hotel, I did discover that the prices of food and other stuffs at Tsuen Wan were really much cheaper than that at Hong Kong Island. If ever I were to go to Hong Kong again, I will definitely return to stay at L'Hotel Nina et Convention Centre!

name: Atlas Guest House & Backpackers
detail: Excellent hotel and owner. I booked this hotel for my fiance while she was traveling alone and there was a misunderstanding with the booking and the owner was very good to work with. He gave me his personal WhatsApp number so he and I could work out all the details. He was very patient and my fiance had a great experience while staying. I would definitely book again while in Hong Kong.

name: Ramada Grand Tsim Sha Tsui
detail: I had an unexpected extra night in Hong Kong so chose this hotel as it is quite new and was cheap. The lobby design is nice and big, check in was very quick. Yes the rooms are very small, mine had a double bed that basically filled the room and the bathroom had a half bath in it, which may have been better suited for just a shower and the bed was quite hard however the room design was new, it was clean, quiet and was fine for the 1 night I had there. If I had to spend a single night in Hong Kong I would have no problem going back there. If I was in Hong Kong for multiple nights I would probably choose a hotel with a bigger room.
area: Tsim Sha Tsui,Hong Kong - View on map

name: The Luxe Manor
detail: i booked a deluxe room at the luxe manor hotel hong kong through agoda.com (so helpful indeed, thank you very much!) with a very competitive rate. firstly i a bit hesitated as never stayed in this boutique hotel when making a business trip in hong kong before. however it turned to be just a very correct decision i made this time. i was so grateful since the first step at the hotel check-in counter, called “touch” which is a personalised concierge service. with the deluxe package booking, the hotel offered a grate deal of services, including every morning delicious buffet breakfast at a stylist restaurant on the first floor, free-of-charge drinks in-room minibar (day-to-day fulfilling too), a posh welcome drink at on 2nd floor bar. after a quick check-in process, a very kind concierge took me to my room on 14 floor to find that the deluxe room was very charmingly touching, smart decoration, not too little, not too much, for everything. i adored a refrigerator which was hidden in a pretty sideboard with a full pack of cool free-drink, as well as a lcd in a picture frame. everything in the room was just perfect, comfortable bed & pillow, equipped bathroom. location of the luxe manor is possibly one of their selling points. it is so conveniently located, either you would love shopping or traveling for business. major transportations are in a short walking distance, both hong kong mtr (underground train system) and a star ferry, if you wish to cross the harbor to central or wanchai. nevertheless, sometime (when lazy to walk) a taxi was also taken to travel between kowloon and central sides. passing through cross-harbour tunnels would be more costly than using the mtr or the ferry, but still in a region of reasonableness. overall, i was truly satisfied with this particular stay at the luxe manor, a small (but luxurious and warmful service) hotel hidden at the heart of tsim sha tsui, hong kong.
area: Tsim Sha Tsui,Hong Kong - View on map

name: Homy Central
detail: I am suppose to book from this hotel during my first trip in Hong Kong but they got sold out really fast! Luckily this January of 2019, I was able to book 2 rooms. The staff that attended our check-in is really efficient and very friendly. The rooms we got are really spacious, very minimalist but that's how we like it and clean. The location is amazing, like 50 steps away from the train station. The price is relatively cheap knowing that this is Hong Kong and were in the central part. Hong Kong holds a special place in our hearts and I will definitely stay in this cozy homy hotel when I come back. Keep up the great service Homy Hotel Central!
